About the Position

This Agder PhD fellowship investigates the use of Norwegian professional language in workplaces. The research is language-specific, so applicants should check the language preparation and disciplinary qualifications required by the employer before applying. University of Agder invites applications for a PhD position in this area: Norwegian Professional Language Use in the Workplace, Agder. The work sits within Linguistics, Education. The host institution is in Various, Norway. Funding covers the full cost of participation; financial support is listed as NOK 550,800/year gross (Norwegian state salary plan 17.510, code 1017). Interested candidates should note the deadline: 9 November 2026.

Research Areas

  • Professional language
  • Norwegian language
  • Workplace research
